shared_elements: bearded male figure with patterned/curled hair and beard
raised or extended arm holding an object
procession/register composition with figures facing one direction
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile carved in low relief, with elaborately patterned hair/beard, extended arms holding objects, and rosettes used as a decorative motif (a rosette bracelet in A, a rosette border band in B); both use a register-based, directional composition. The biggest difference in content is that A depicts a single large winged supernatural figure filling the field, while B shows a small-scale procession of unwinged men leading a camel along a horizontal band.
